rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for physically writhing or fidgeting, especially when trying to get free.

example.english: They kept trying to squirm free after someone grabbed their hand.
example.traditional: 佢畀人捉住隻手，扭嚟扭去都想掙脫。
example.jyutping: keoi5 bei2 jan4 zuk1 zyu6 zek3 sau2 nau2 lai4 nau2 heoi3 dou1 soeng2 zang1 tyut3

rows.note: Use this when the squirming is chiefly caused by embarrassment, shame, or mental discomfort rather than an attempt to escape.

example.english: After the teacher scolded them in front of everyone, they squirm with embarrassment throughout the lesson.
example.traditional: 畀老師當眾鬧完，佢成堂都坐立不安，尷尬到面都紅晒。
example.jyutping: bei2 lou5 si1 dong1 zung3 naau6 jyun4 keoi5 seng4 tong4 dou1 zo6 laap6 bat1 on1 gaam3 gaai3 dou3 min6 dou1 hung4 saai3
